hero.subtitle: Enterprise AI Governance Command Center. Unify software, AI agents, and enterprise platforms into one governed layer where every action is authorized, logged, and reversible.

governance.label: Absolute Command
governance.description: 中文：You issue the directive. OmniHub orchestrates every connected system with full real-time visibility. Actions logged. Agents tracked. Outcomes traceable.

naturalLanguage.title: 中文：Natural language directives
naturalLanguage.desc: Issue commands in plain language. OmniHub translates intent into structured task plans across your agent network.

capabilityRouting.title: 中文：Capability-matched routing
capabilityRouting.desc: 中文：Each task routes to the most qualified agent. No guesswork, no misroutes, full audit of each routing decision.

override.title: 中文：Override any agent, instantly
override.desc: One command halts, redirects, or replaces any running agent mid-execution. You remain in full control.

reversible.label: 中文：Architectural Primitive
reversible.description: 中文：The only enterprise AI platform where rollback is a first-class architectural primitive. One bad decision does not cascade. You undo it. Completely.

rollback.title: 中文：One-click rollback
rollback.desc: 中文：Reverse any agent action or workflow state with a single command. No cleanup required.

blastRadius.title: 中文：Blast radius containment
blastRadius.desc: 中文：OmniHub detects propagation risk and contains failures before they cascade across connected systems.

compensating.title: 中文：Compensating transactions
compensating.desc: Each agent action carries a compensating operation. Distributed state stays coherent under rollback.

policyRules.name: 中文：Scope Restriction
policyRules.desc: 中文：No agent accesses unauthorized data scopes

policyRules.name: 中文：Audit on Write
policyRules.desc: 中文：Each write operation logged immutably
